question.problem:
$$
{{[\begin{aligned}3 & -7 & 4 \\ -3 & 1 & 7 \\ -3 & 7 & -6\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{A}={{[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ -1 & 1 & 0 \\ -1 & \boxed{} & 1\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{L}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}3 & -7 & 4 \\ 0 & -6 & 11 \\ 0 & 0 & -2\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{U}
$$

Consider the LU factorization of the matrix $A$ above. What is the value of the entry ${l}_{32}$ in the matrix $L?$
question.worked_solution:
The matrix $U$ in the LU decomposition is obtained from the original matrix $A$ by row-reducing using Gaussian elementation. In particular, to make zeros below the main diagonal, we proceed as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}3 & -7 & 4 \\ -3 & 1 & 7 \\ -3 & 7 & -6\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+1{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}3 & -7 & 4 \\ 0 & -6 & 11 \\ -3 & 7 & -6\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+1{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}3 & -7 & 4 \\ 0 & -6 & 11 \\ 0 & 0 & -2\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Notice that the position ${a}_{32}$ is already $0.$ Therefore, the entry ${l}_{32}$ of the matrix $L$ is

$$
{l}_{32}=0.
$$
